subject: maths
source_note: Topic structure follows the IB Diploma Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches (AA) guide, the route chosen here for its emphasis on calculus and proof; Applications and Interpretation (AI) is the alternative IB mathematics route. HL adds the AHL content shown with an (HL) suffix. Topic names are guide-accurate; connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (the IB does not publish these).
